subject.title: [Bug]: Write/exec tool parameters silently dropped after long conversations (content/command missing)

question: Should this issue remain the broad canonical tracker for long-session cross-tool argument loss, or should maintainers split it into narrower Tool Search and provider-streaming issues now?
rationale: Current source proves one Tool Search subset, but the original report and later live comments span providers, long sessions, large payloads, and state drift; automation cannot safely decide the permanent product/debugging boundary.

options.title: Keep broad tracker canonical
options.body: Keep this issue open for the cross-provider long-session failure while reviewing the narrower Tool Search PR as only a partial fix.

options.title: Split into narrower trackers
options.body: Close or narrow this issue only after opening maintainer-owned follow-ups for provider streaming, large payloads, and Tool Search wrapper behavior.

options.title: Treat Tool Search as canonical
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96115 the only remaining tracker if maintainers accept that the older provider/large-payload evidence is no longer actionable.

recommendation.title: Keep broad tracker canonical
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for the cross-provider long-session failure while reviewing the narrower Tool Search PR as only a partial fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Tool Search and the extracted AI runtime history make this the strongest routing candidate for deciding the tracker boundary.
